svg.title: How much of each preview is visibly colorful?
svg.desc: Colorful pixel share by content domain in 1119 distinct files. Domains are ordered by the median share. Points mark per-file medians, bands show the 25th to 75th percentiles, and file counts appear separately. Short story: 45.9% median, 112 files; Music video: 45.5% median, 77 files; Games / interactive: 42.8% median, 230 files; History / culture: 40.0% median, 49 files; Art / abstract: 37.9% median, 42 files; Humor / meme: 33.2% median, 23 files; AI about AI: 26.7% median, 201 files; Education / science: 23.6% median, 147 files; Data visualization: 21.6% median, 14 files; Ads / launches: 17.6% median, 215 files; Other: 14.9% median, 9 files.
svg.title: How much of each preview is visibly colorful?
